name: PPC Flexible Packaging
old_description: As a leading manufacturer of custom flexible packaging, we proudly serve clients across the globe. No matter the industry, we work hard to understand your business and create the perfect custom flexible packaging for your organization. With our unmatched team, commitment to sustainability, and ability to create sterilizable packaging materials, we’re the best choice for your business.
about:
PPC Flexible Packaging operates from Buffalo Grove, Illinois, where it runs an advanced flexible packaging manufacturing operation. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a manufacturer focused on purposeful, powerful packaging solutions.

The company produces custom flexible packaging including pouches, bags, rollstock, reclosable packaging, and cleanroom stock products. Its capabilities span prototyping (with 86% of projects turned around in two days or less), in-house design and graphics, digital and flexographic printing (G7 Master certified), regular and extrusion lamination, converting, finishing, quality control, and distribution. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

PPC Flex serves markets including food (snack, frozen, bakery), healthcare and specialty (sterile packaging, microelectronics), petcare, nutraceuticals, fresh produce, floral, consumer packaging, and cleaning products. Customers range from pet food and snack companies to candy and chip manufacturers, as reflected in testimonials.

The company emphasizes an agile, experienced approach that combines nimble systems, a passionate team, and leading-edge innovations to manage complexity from design to shipment. It highlights its G7 Master Printer and GMI certifications as validation of quality and color consistency.
